journal.en: They drink the air and hold the stone.

plausibility.summary: At 350 g and limbless, storm surf and F19 wind load favour low profile and strong substrate adhesion on steep andesite shore (F9). Tenacious pedal or ventral mucus is standard for intertidal grazers; 1.6 bar air does not weaken underwater adhesion much but does make emersion drying real when waves fail. Spiral resting posture and mucus glint match observable intertidal behaviour.

plausibility.summary: Low-tide emersion on dark basalt still drives water loss even in humid 1.6 bar air; shifting feeding to night, moonlit periods (F6), and foggy dawns (F8, F16) is classic intertidal scheduling. Long twilight (F3) extends safe exit windows. West-coast shore (F18) is wetter than the start valley, so desiccation is moderate not extreme; nocturnality still pays on spring midday low tides.
